task.goal: Produce a multi-slide editorial carousel that juxtaposes lifestyle/fashion photography with short philosophical text overlays interrogating AI-driven authenticity and 'proof of human' themes.
task.success_condition: Output is a coherent slide sequence (headline slide + supporting image/quote slides) that reads as editorial commentary, preserves the juxtaposition structure (image-led slide / text-led slide alternation) seen in the reference specimens, and does not resolve into literal ad copy for an identity-verification product.
task.atomic_boundary: Covers slide sequencing, image/text juxtaposition, and pull-quote placement for one carousel. Does not cover caption copywriting for the post itself, distribution, or any downstream identity-verification product claims.

source_expression_moment.description: The editorial moment or thesis driving this carousel (e.g. the specific 'proof of human' angle being explored).

voice_context.description: Tone/register constraints for the text overlays (e.g. wry, declarative, non-corporate).

slides.description: Ordered slide sequence, each slide typed as image-led or text-overlay, matching the juxtaposition pattern of the reference specimens.

acceptance_tests: Sequence alternates image-only and text-overlay slides in a pattern consistent with the reference specimens.
No slide resolves the AI/authenticity theme into a literal product pitch.
Headline and pull-quote slides remain legible against background imagery at carousel thumbnail size.

activative_input.hidden_pressure: The felt tension between wanting to look effortlessly authentic and knowing authenticity itself is now producible/fakeable.
activation_directions: Invite the viewer to sit with the discomfort rather than resolve it into a call-to-action.
stakes: Personal identity as something now provable rather than assumed
identity_urges: Wanting to be seen as genuinely, verifiably human
activative_input.participation_design: Passive scroll-through consumption; no explicit CTA within the carousel itself.
activative_input.intended_reaction: A beat of unease/recognition, not a purchase impulse.
activative_input.smallest_useful_commitment: Viewer pauses on the headline slide before swiping.
wrong_reading_locks: Do not let the AI/authenticity juxtaposition read as promotion or glamorization of AI-generated deception — the format critiques the erosion of trust, it does not celebrate the tools that cause it.

Do not resolve the carousel into literal ad copy for an identity-verification or 'proof of human' product — the specimens are editorial commentary, not a product pitch, and text overlays must not imply a purchasable solution.

Do not treat the fashion/lifestyle imagery as the message — the images are deliberately ambiguous (could be real or AI-generated) in service of the text's thesis; do not caption or crop them in a way that resolves that ambiguity, which would collapse the format's central tension.
wrong_reading_locks_meaning: Do not replace authentic human proof with corporate testimonials -- PRM-PSY-018 requires raw unpolished evidence.
Do not force immediate agreement -- EXP-FBK-004 allows self-guided reflection.
